speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Look at him, a hand on my wainscot, and it is not yet noon. What have you lifted?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: An armour-basket, out of Will Sly's way. I came by every wall.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I fetch the little pot of bay grease your mother put in your pack?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fetch it, girl. He can have the stair one step at a time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I played Gaunt from a stool the rest of the morning. I am not cast this afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the afternoon is the chamber. Up you go.
